products.name: Microsoft Teams Phone Enablement — Calling Plans & Operator Connect — Commercial
products.short_description: Enable Teams Phone via Calling Plans / Operator Connect — licensing, number acquisition + assignment, voice-routing + emergency-calling policy, auto attendants/call queues, and validation — so users get reliable enterprise calling. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn on enterprise voice in Teams Phone — calling plans and Operator Connect

Moving telephony into Teams Phone means choosing the right PSTN connectivity and getting numbers, policies, and emergency calling right. This solution enables Teams Phone via Microsoft Calling Plans and Operator Connect (the non-SBC paths): licensing, phone-number acquisition and assignment, calling/voice-routing and emergency-calling policy, auto attendants and call queues, and validation — so users get reliable enterprise calling. (Direct Routing via SBC is covered separately.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — PSTN options (Calling Plans vs Operator Connect vs Direct Routing), licensing, numbers, voice routing, emergency calling, auto attendants/call queues.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams Phone + calling-plan/Operator-Connect licensing, admin roles, number inventory, E911 addresses).
  • Implementation Guide — assign licensing, acquire + assign numbers (Calling Plans or Operator Connect), set voice-routing + emergency-calling + calling policies, build auto attendants/call queues, and validate — pilot-first, each object named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (calls in/out work, emergency calling correct, policies assigned) plus Best Practices for a reliable Teams Phone rollout.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Enterprise calling live in Teams Phone — the right PSTN path chosen, numbers assigned, emergency calling correct, auto attendants and queues working — reliable voice for users.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TEAMSPHONE-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Teams Phone readiness, number, and voice-policy inventory (MicrosoftTeams module)
    • TEAMSPHONE-Scope.ps1 — read-only pilot/target-group readiness + tenant PSTN scope helper
    • TEAMSPHONE-Set-NumbersAndPolicy.ps1 — assign phone numbers + grant voice policies for Teams Phone users. Defaults to -WhatIf
    • TEAMSPHONE-Set-VoiceApps.ps1 — create/associate resource accounts, a call queue, and an auto attendant. Defaults to -WhatIf
    • TEAMSPHONE-Validation.ps1 — validate calling + emergency-calling readiness per user (read-only report)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
